Portuguese:
##**Atenção:** A competição não contará com a modalidade 3x3x3 normal, mas **somente** a modalidade **3x3 em menos movimentos**. [Clique aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/#article-E-fewest-moves) para obter mais informações sobre as regras específicas para essa modalidade.

Para pagamentos da taxa de inscrição de R$17,00, utilize o PIX e envie o comprovante com o seu nome completo para o contato:
PIX: fbgrac@gmail.com
(por favor, identifique o nome do competidor na descrição do pix)

Inscrições no local serão permitidas no valor de R$ 20,00.


English:
##**Attention:** The competition will hold **only** the **3x3 fewest moves** event. [Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) to get more information about the specific regulations for this event.

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

**PLEASE NOTE: This competition is part of a series with Central Washington Evens 2025. Competitors are allowed to only compete in 1 competition. You can see more information on the Competition Series tab.**
